categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在模型结构自优化、记忆与分子动力学的高效模拟，以及空间推理与评估指标的补短板。

articles.title: Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance
articles.zh: 无方差假设下的最优线性回归
articles.summary: 如果你在做线性回归时默认"方差已知"这个前提，这篇提醒你这个假设一旦不成立，最优解的构造会完全不同。
articles.author: Artin Tajdini, Jasper C. H. Lee 等
articles.body: We study high-probability linear regression in the infinite variance regime, wherecthe regression noise has only a finite conditional $α$-moment $ν$ for some unknown $α\in(1,2)$, and the covariates may only have finite moments up to a given order (e.g., 4th moment). We give a black-box reduction that converts finite-variance regression procedures into weak-moment procedures. The reduction is based on empirical residual pruning and is agnostic to the moment exponent, the noise scale, the covariance, and the design moment. Under a finite fourth-moment condition on the covariates, any finite-variance subroutine attaining the sub-Gaussian rate yields the following when the number of samples $n$ is above a suitably defined threshold: Without knowing $α$ or $ν$, we have with probability at least $1-δ$ that $ \|\widehatθ-θ^*\|_Σ \lesssim_α ν^{1/α} \big(\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n}\big)^{\frac{α-1}α}, $ where $d$ is the dimension, $Σ$ is the covariate covariance matrix, and $\|v\|_Σ:=(v^\topΣv)^{1/2}$. We further prove a matching minimax lower bound that holds under the same conditions. The reduction is computationally efficient whenever the finite-variance subroutine is. We also obtain a distribution-free prediction guarantee under a bounded raw $α$-moment assumption on the response, and give an analogous $α$-agnostic reduction for mean estimation.
articles.bodyZh: 我们研究的是无限方差情形下的高概率线性回归（high-probability linear regression）。这里回归噪声只有有限的条件 α 阶矩（conditional α-moment）ν，α 是未知的，落在 (1,2) 之间；协变量也可能只有有限阶矩，比如四阶矩。我们给出一个黑箱归约（black-box reduction），能把有限方差的回归流程转成弱矩流程（weak-moment procedures）。这个归约靠经验残差剪枝（empirical residual pruning）来实现，而且不用管矩指数（moment exponent）、噪声尺度、协方差和设计矩（design moment）。在协变量满足有限四阶矩的条件下，任何达到亚高斯速率（sub-Gaussian rate）的有限方差子程序，在样本数 n 超过一个合适设定的阈值后，都会得到下面这个结果：我们不用知道 α 或 ν，也有至少 1-δ 的概率满足 \(\|\widehat{\theta}-\theta^*\|_\Sigma \lesssim_\alpha \nu^{1/\alpha}\left(\frac{d+\log(1/\delta)}{n}\right)^{\frac{\alpha-1}{\alpha}}\)，其中 d 是维度，Σ 是协变量协方差矩阵，\(\|v\|_\Sigma:=(v^\top\Sigma v)^{1/2}\)。我们还证明了一个匹配的极小极大下界（minimax lower bound），它在同样条件下成立。只要有限方差子程序本身计算高效，这个归约也计算高效。另外，在响应变量有有界原始 α 阶矩的假设下，我们得到一个无分布预测保证（distribution-free prediction guarantee），并给出了一个类似的、不依赖 α 的归约，用于均值估计（mean estimation）。

articles.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
articles.zh: MemOnce：面向大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
articles.summary: 如果你正在给LLM搭长期记忆模块，这套架构值得看一眼它在容量扩展和记忆写入成本之间怎么取舍。
articles.author: Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu 等
articles.body: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.
articles.bodyZh: 要在长程、持续交互中部署大语言模型（LLMs），就得为后续推理保留可复用的记忆状态，这对现有架构来说是个不小的挑战。标准Transformer（Transformer）会逐层、逐词元（token）地累积KV缓存（KV caches），上下文一长，GPU显存就线性增长，计算复杂度也会按平方级往上飙。相比之下，线性时间架构能把历史压缩进固定大小的状态里，但细粒度细节很难保住。我们提出MemOnce，一种能为语言模型学习可扩展记忆状态的基础架构。它有两个核心设计：一是记忆编码器-解码器（Memory encoder-decoder），只把最后一层隐藏状态里的一小部分缓存成紧凑的记忆表示，再动态解码回注意力层需要的KV缓存；二是记忆稀疏注意力（Memory sparse attention），对每个持续输入，MemOnce会自适应地检索相关记忆表示，而且稀疏索引在所有层之间只算一次。这两个设计配合起来，就能高效地即时加载记忆、解码KV缓存，大幅降低GPU显存占用，并实现线性时间复杂度。我们做了大量实验，结果表明，在不同模型规模、上下文长度和训练范式（预训练和后训练适配）下，MemOnce都优于Transformer和其他架构。尤其是用MemOnce适配Qwen3.5-4B后，在100万上下文下，记忆状态缓存减少了1313倍，预填充延迟降低了6.9倍，吞吐量提升了3.5倍，整体记忆性能提升了5.77%。最后，MemOnce还能零样本泛化到下游表示任务，效果和专用模型相比也很有竞争力。

articles.title: Non-penetrating World Models
articles.summary: 如果你用世界模型做机器人或物理仿真，物体互相穿透这个老毛病，这篇从建模层面给了个解法。
articles.author: Yuhang Dai, Yinwei Wu 等
articles.body: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
articles.bodyZh: 我们研究的是交互式视频世界模型（interactive video world models）里怎么防止物体穿透（object penetration），这是一个新问题。为了搞清楚现有模型都是怎么处理这个问题的，我们做了 NoPeBench 这个基准测试（benchmark），专门评估世界模型碰到物理障碍物时会怎么反应。评测结果发现，没有哪个开源模型能稳定地避免这类出错。但有意思的是，这些模型其实已经编码了预测这类违规所需的信息。我们发现，扩散变换器（diffusion transformers, DiTs）的隐藏状态（hidden states）能预测一个候选动作会不会穿透障碍物。基于这个发现，我们提出了 NoPeWorld，一个轻量级框架，用来检测并阻止穿透。具体来说，我们在一个冻结的 DiT 的隐藏状态上面训练一个很小的预测头（prediction head），让它读出某个候选动作安不安全。不安全的动作会被替换成最接近原本意图的安全动作。方法虽然简单，但 NoPeWorld 把六个视频世界模型平均的物理违规率（physical violation rate）从 74% 大幅降到了 16%。更值得一提的是，我们的方法还能零样本泛化（zero-shot generalization）到开放域图像（open-domain imagery）、第三人称视角（third-person viewpoints）和动态障碍物（moving obstacles）。我们会公开代码、NoPeBench 基准测试和模型权重。项目主页：https://nopeworld.github.io 。

articles.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
articles.zh: Model Carving：训练能自行优化拓扑结构的 Transformer
articles.summary: 如果你嫌剪枝加NAS两步走太折腾，这篇让模型在训练过程中自己"雕刻"出自己的结构。
articles.author: Kaden Zheng, Pratyusha Sharma
articles.body: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. A classic Transformer, for instance, trains a fixed set of attention and MLP sublayers at every layer, in the same order, and optimizes the weights within. This uniformity is a convention rather than a principled design choice, and it is likely suboptimal: the best architecture for a given task may be smaller, more efficient, and far from uniform. We believe that, ideally, training itself should shape the model's topology. To this end, we introduce Model Carving, which learns both a Transformer's weights and its architecture in a single run. By applying learnable, scalar gates to each sublayer, we allow the training loss to remove the model's own components during training -- freeing a smaller heterogeneous network inside. We evaluate Model Carving by pre-training standard Transformers from 140M to 2.7B parameters and looped Transformers from 140M to 1.3B. At equal training compute, carved models reach a lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute. Furthermore, carved models also outperform size-matched models produced by pruning or distillation, suggesting that the best way to obtain small models for edge devices is to carve them during training, not to compress a large one afterwards. This advantage both grows with scale and carries over to downstream tasks such as few-shot evaluation and generation. Because the removed sublayers no longer run, carved models also cost up to 34% fewer FLOPs per token and decode up to 1.6 times faster without cost in quality. Our results show that architecture, like weights, should be learned and not fixed in advance, and that inside every large transformer is a smaller, faster, stronger one waiting to be carved out.
articles.bodyZh: 机器学习长期以来基本把“选架构”和“做训练”这两件事分开来看。比如一个经典 Transformer（Transformer），每一层都按同样的顺序训练固定的一组注意力子层和多层感知机（MLP）子层，只优化里面的权重。这种整齐划一更多是习惯做法，而不是有原则的设计选择，而且很可能不是最优：对某个任务来说，最好的架构可能更小、更高效，也远没有那么统一。我们认为，理想情况下，训练本身就应该塑造模型的拓扑结构（topology）。为此，我们提出 Model Carving（模型雕刻），它能在一次训练中同时学习 Transformer 的权重和架构。我们给每个子层加上可学习的标量门控（scalar gates），让训练损失在训练过程中把模型自己的组件去掉，从而释放出里面一个更小的异构网络（heterogeneous network）。我们通过预训练 1.4 亿到 27 亿参数的标准 Transformer，以及 1.4 亿到 13 亿参数的循环 Transformer（looped Transformers），来评估 Model Carving。在相同训练算力下，雕刻出来的模型比用最多 1.7 倍算力训练出来的稠密模型（dense models）达到更低的验证损失（validation loss）。此外，雕刻模型也优于通过剪枝（pruning）或蒸馏（distillation）得到的同尺寸模型，这说明给边缘设备（edge devices）做小模型的最好办法，是在训练时直接把它“雕”出来，而不是事后压缩一个大模型。这个优势还会随着规模变大而增强，并且能延续到下游任务，比如少样本评估（few-shot evaluation）和生成（generation）。由于被去掉的子层不再运行，雕刻模型每个 token 的浮点运算次数（FLOPs）最多少 34%，解码速度最多快 1.6 倍，而质量不下降。我们的结果表明，架构和权重一样，应该被学习出来，而不是事先固定；每一个大 Transformer 里面，都藏着一个更小、更快、更强的模型，等着被雕刻出来。

articles.title: BioEmu2: Scalable Emulation of Biomolecular Dynamics
articles.zh: BioEmu2：可扩展的生物分子动力学模拟
articles.summary: 如果你关心蛋白质构象模拟，这条用学习模型替代昂贵MD仿真的路线又往前推了一步。
articles.author: Michael Gastegger, Adam E. Foster 等
articles.body: Despite major advances in structure prediction, modelling the motions and interactions that drive biomolecular function at scale remains a central challenge. We introduce BioEmu2, a generative model for atomically resolved biomolecular structures combining static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling and time evolution, that samples orders of magnitude faster than molecular dynamics (MD). Trained on experimental and synthetic structures and extensive MD data, it supports multi-component systems containing proteins, nucleic acids, modified residues, ligands and ions. Structure-prediction accuracy is comparable to top open-weight biomolecular folding models, and a context parallel mode enables prediction of megadalton complexes. Equilibrium distributions approximate MD references with free-energy errors near 1 kcal/mol across tested proteins and complexes. Time propagation predicts long-timescale dynamical trajectories and kinetics of binding and conformational changes. Generated structures can be controlled by conditioning on residue contacts or steering with user-defined bias potentials. Enhanced sampling enables free energy calculation involving rare states. BioEmu2 makes the study of biomolecular ensembles and dynamics scalable.
articles.bodyZh: 尽管结构预测已经取得了很大进展，但要在大规模上模拟驱动生物分子功能的运动和相互作用，仍然是个核心难题。这里介绍 BioEmu2：它是一个面向原子分辨率（atomically resolved）生物分子结构的生成模型（generative model），把静态结构预测（static structure prediction）、平衡采样（equilibrium sampling）和时间演化（time evolution）合到了一起，采样速度比分子动力学（MD）快好几个数量级。它用实验结构、合成结构以及大量 MD 数据训练，能处理包含蛋白质（proteins）、核酸（nucleic acids）、修饰残基（modified residues）、配体（ligands）和离子（ions）的多组分系统（multi-component systems）。它的结构预测精度能跟顶尖的开放权重（open-weight）生物分子折叠模型相比，而且通过上下文并行（context parallel）模式，可以预测兆道尔顿级复合物（megadalton complexes）。在测试过的蛋白质和复合物上，它的平衡分布（equilibrium distributions）能接近 MD 参考结果，自由能误差大约在 1 kcal/mol 左右。时间传播（time propagation）能预测长时间尺度的动力学轨迹（dynamical trajectories），以及结合和构象变化的动力学（kinetics）。生成出来的结构还能通过残基接触（residue contacts）做条件控制，或者用用户自定义的偏置势（bias potentials）来引导。增强采样（enhanced sampling）让涉及罕见状态（rare states）的自由能计算（free energy calculation）也能做。BioEmu2 让生物分子系综（ensembles）和动力学（dynamics）的研究变得可规模化。

articles.title: SUAF: Spectral Universal Advantage Features for Zero-Shot Policy Improvement
articles.zh: SUAF：用于零样本策略改进的谱域通用优势特征
articles.summary: 如果你在做离线强化学习、想不动原策略就拿到零样本提升，这套谱域特征可以直接当插件试。
articles.author: Huaze Tang, Runqing Miao 等
articles.body: Reward-independent representations enable reinforcement learning agents to reuse knowledge across tasks, but limited representation capacity raises three fundamental questions: what statistical dependence should these representations capture, which components of that dependence should be retained for policy improvement, and how does discarding the remaining components affect decision-making? We address these questions through canonical dependence analysis. For a reference policy, we construct an action-centered, positive-lag canonical dependence matrix (CDM) that isolates the additional predictive contribution of the current action beyond the current state. Its singular value decomposition yields Spectral Universal Advantage Features (SUAF), paired features that recover delayed advantage through linear reward projections. We show that the spectrum quantifies mutual information between current action and future state-action visitation conditioned on current state and determines reward specific approximation errors. Retaining the leading modes gives optimal rank-constrained approximations under both isotropic average-case and reward-uniform minimax criteria. Separating the immediate reward contrast also avoids the spectral floor arising from direct compression of the full advantage operator. To learn SUAF from reward-free data, we develop an action-centered Soft-HGR objective with bidirectional temporal-difference estimation. We further connect spectral approximation errors to sufficient conditions for policy improvement. Finite-state experiments validate the spectral predictions and feature-learning method, while zero-shot evaluations on discrete tasks and continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the utility of the learned representations across rewards.
articles.bodyZh: 跟奖励无关的表征（reward-independent representations）能让强化学习智能体把知识跨任务复用，但表征容量有限，就引出三个根本问题：这种表征该抓住哪些统计依赖？这些依赖里哪些部分该留下来帮助策略改进？把剩下的部分丢掉，又会怎样影响决策？我们用规范依赖分析（canonical dependence analysis）来回答。给定一个参考策略，我们构造以动作为中心、正滞后的规范依赖矩阵（CDM），把“当前动作除了当前状态之外，还额外带来多少预测信息”单独拎出来。对它做奇异值分解（SVD），就得到谱通用优势特征（SUAF）——成对的特征能通过线性奖励投影还原出延迟优势。我们发现，这个谱能衡量：在给定当前状态的条件下，当前动作和未来状态-动作访问之间的互信息（mutual information），也能决定针对具体奖励的近似误差。保留最重要的那些模式，就能在各向同性平均情形（isotropic average-case）和奖励均匀的极小极大准则（reward-uniform minimax criteria）下，得到最优的秩约束近似（rank-constrained approximations）。把即时奖励对比（immediate reward contrast）单独拆出来，还能避开直接压缩完整优势算子（full advantage operator）时出现的谱底（spectral floor）。为了从无奖励数据里学出SUAF，我们提出一个以动作为中心的软HGR目标（Soft-HGR objective），并用双向时序差分估计（bidirectional temporal-difference estimation）。我们还进一步把谱近似误差和策略改进（policy improvement）的充分条件（sufficient conditions）联系起来。有限状态实验验证了谱预测和特征学习方法；而在离散任务和连续控制基准（continuous-control benchmarks）上的零样本评估（zero-shot evaluations）表明，学到的表征能跨不同奖励发挥作用。

articles.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
articles.zh: StereoVLM：面向度量级3D空间推理的双目视觉语言模型
articles.summary: 如果你想让VLM真的说准"那东西有多远"，双目加度量级空间推理比单目猜深度靠谱得多。
articles.author: Chi Yan, Guoyang Zhao 等
articles.body: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($δ_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.
articles.bodyZh: 视觉语言模型（Vision-language models, VLMs）在语义理解上很强，但在对真实物理世界里有尺度的三维空间（metric 3D space）做推理时，能力仍然有限。现有的 VLM 通常是在相机没有已知标定（camera calibration）、也没有跨视角几何约束（cross-view geometric constraints）的情况下，从一张或多张图片里推断三维场景结构。这就让带尺度的三维推断本身变得有歧义，也让人说不清它们的空间预测到底是有视觉证据撑着，还是主要被语义先验（semantic priors）带着跑。相比之下，标定好的双目（calibrated stereo）能提供明确的跨视角几何，正好消除这种歧义，也为带尺度的三维感知和几何泛化提供更可靠的基础。我们研究 VLM 怎样才能直接从标定好的双目观测（binocular observations）里学到可迁移的三维表征（3D representations）。为此，我们提出 StereoVLM，这是第一个能做带尺度三维空间推理的几何感知双目 VLM。StereoVLM 采用一套分层学习范式（hierarchical learning paradigm），从跨视角对应（cross-view correspondence）和视差估计（disparity estimation），一路学到以标定为条件、带真实尺度的深度感知（calibration-conditioned metric depth perception）和语义空间推理（semantic spatial reasoning）。我们还发现，在没见过的环境里，视差监督（disparity supervision）的泛化效果明显好于直接的双目深度监督（binocular depth supervision）。为了评估这些能力，我们推出 Stereo3D-Bench，这是一个分三个层级的综合基准，从点级几何（point-level geometry）一直到物体级空间推理（object-level spatial reasoning）。StereoVLM-8B 在 Stereo3D-Bench 上达到 95.17% 的深度准确率（δ1），物体级平均分 66.98。干预实验（intervention）的结果还表明，模型在 Stereo3D-Bench 上的表现受益于有效的跨视角几何，不能只靠额外视觉 token 或语义先验来解释。分层几何监督（hierarchical geometric supervision）也在五个空间基准上平均带来 3.54 分提升，并让 RoboCasa 操作任务成功率提高 4.3 个百分点。

articles.title: Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances
articles.zh: Star Panoptic Quality：选择性评估分裂与合并实例
articles.summary: 如果你的分割模型总在密集场景里把实例拆错或粘成一坨，这个新指标能把这类错误单独拎出来算账。
articles.author: Erik Großkopf, Paula Tamara Buzduga 等
articles.body: Detecting individual instances is crucial for many segmentation problems. However, expert instance annotations are often unavailable, so instances are approximated heuristically (e.g., as connected components of semantic maps), which can merge touching objects or split fragmented ones. Even when expert annotations exist, expert disagreement or structural delineation biases can yield split or merged reference instances, corresponding to over- or under-segmentation, respectively. Panoptic Quality (PQ) and related metrics capture both segmentation and detection quality while weighting all instances equally, regardless of size. Yet when the references are biased, these metrics can neither detect split or merged instances nor distinguish valid from invalid overor under-segmentation. We present Star Panoptic Quality (StarPQ), a novel evaluation ramework, which closes this gap in two steps: First, we construct a so-called star forest in the bipartite graph whose clean, merge, and split stars isolate different failure modes. Second, we calculate the final metric by individually weighting each failure mode, allowing practitioners to account for instance delineation biases. Across various experiments, we demonstrate that StarPQ not only enables targeted penalization or eniency towards specific failure modes, but also serves as a diagnostic tool to reveal their prevalence.
articles.bodyZh: 检测出每一个单独实例，对很多分割问题来说都特别关键。但现实里，专家标注的实例数据经常拿不到，所以只能用一些启发式方法（heuristic）去近似实例，比如把语义图里的连通分量（connected components of semantic maps）当成实例。这么干的问题是，本来挨在一起的两个物体可能被合并成一个，本来碎成几块的同一个物体又可能被拆开。就算有专家标注，专家之间意见不一致，或者勾画结构时带有偏差，也会产生被拆开或被合并的参考实例，分别对应过分割（over-segmentation）和欠分割（under-segmentation）。全景质量（Panoptic Quality，PQ）以及相关指标，能同时衡量分割质量和检测质量，但它们对所有实例一视同仁地加权，不管实例大小。可当参考标注本身有偏差时，这些指标既发现不了被拆开或被合并的实例，也分不清哪些过分割或欠分割是合理的、哪些是不合理的。我们提出了星全景质量（Star Panoptic Quality，StarPQ），这是一个新的评估框架，分两步补上这个缺口：第一步，在二部图（bipartite graph）里构造所谓的星形森林（star forest），用干净星、合并星和拆分星把不同的错误类型区分开；第二步，分别给每种错误类型加权，算出最终指标，这样从业者就能把实例勾画偏差考虑进去。通过一系列实验，我们证明 StarPQ 不仅能针对特定错误类型进行惩罚或宽容，还能当作诊断工具，揭示这些错误到底有多常见。
